angularDiameterSource: Vega is a rapid rotator seen nearly pole-on: Monnier et al. (2012), ApJ 761, L3, measure an equatorial radius of 2.726 ± 0.006 and a polar radius of 2.418 ± 0.012 solar radii with CHARA/MIRC. The record's radius is the volume-equivalent sphere of those two, 2.62 solar radii; the flattening is not drawn.
distanceSource: Inverse of the Hipparcos new-reduction parallax 130.23 ± 0.36 mas (van Leeuwen 2007) via SIMBAD
radiusSource: Radius: Vega is a rapid rotator seen nearly pole-on: Monnier et al. (2012), ApJ 761, L3, measure an equatorial radius of 2.726 ± 0.006 and a polar radius of 2.418 ± 0.012 solar radii with CHARA/MIRC. The record's radius is the volume-equivalent sphere of those two, 2.62 solar radii; the flattening is not drawn. Adopted 1,822,180 km, 2.6192 solar radii at 695700 km per solar radius.
